Attack Shark CM02 Black/Red Contour eSport Gaming Mouse Pad (450 x 400 mm / Speed-Control Surface)

Take your competitive aiming precision to the next level with the Attack Shark CM02 Black/Red Contour eSport gaming mouse pad, brought to you by Turbo Computer Egypt. Specifically engineered for professional eSports competitors, this premium mousepad features a striking black and red contour line design framework on a high-density speed-control hybrid surface. Crafted from a specialized blend of microfiber and slightly textured weave, it delivers an exceptional balance of low-friction gliding speed and outstanding stopping power matrix for perfect mouse micro-adjustments. Measuring a spacious 450x400mm with a comfortable 4mm thickness profile, it provides ample wrist support and movement range. The surface is enhanced with a 5S protective coating architecture to repel water and stains configuration, making it incredibly easy to clean. Anchored by a high-grip natural rubber base layout and finished with tight micro-stitched anti-fraying borders design, this durable Black/Red Contour pad ensures unbeatable stability and lifespan configuration.
